title: ZEISS SMT CEO: China 15 Years Behind in Top Chip Tools
description:
Frank Rohmund, CEO of Zeiss SMT, a key supplier to ASML's EUV lithography machines, sayd he expects that Beijing will need 15 years to develop EUV lithography machine, and additional export controls will only accelerates innovation in China.
He speaks with Bloomberg's Stephen Engle on the sidelines of Semicon Taiwan.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chevron CEO Says Patience Pays Off in Giant Venezuela Oil Deal
description: Big Oil has often employed the “hang around” playbook: secure legal rights to a giant resource — and then, eventually, figure out how to produce it profitably. But few companies have taken it to the extremes of Chevron Corp.
